notes:
Lead: VP Product (Claire Hsu) — building an in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows + progressive disclosure). Primary goal: reduce time-to-first-success (TFS) for new users and deflect support.

POC scope (agreed high-level):
- 2-week POC using Hosted API with streaming + function/tool-calling to wire up product actions (open, highlight, set-user-pref).
- Controlled beta (500 DAUs simulated; ~10k messages/day equivalent).
- Measure user perceived latency (E2E) and token cost per successful onboarding flow.
- Run A/B: current client-side heuristics vs Redwood-driven copilot.

Perf / SLO requirements (engineering asks):
- First-stream token latency target: <200ms typical (p50), p95 <450ms for hosted traffic in NA.
- End-to-end user-perceived reply (streaming complete) <600ms for short guidance flows (3-6 tokens).
- Must maintain stable latency — large variance is a blocker.

Cost & pricing notes:
- High sensitivity to token cost: product team wants a per-flow token cap (e.g., 200 tokens max) with guardrails; ask for batching/caching recommendations to reduce unit cost.
- Finance exploring a monthly reserved capacity for Dedicated if POC meets SLO — looking at commit in the 50k-150k ARR band.

Model preferences / routing:
- Prefer open/instruction-tuned models initially (cost + auditability). Will accept Redwood-curated model variants.
- Want ability to route fallback to smaller quantized variant under load (automated fallback).
- Tool-calling required: execute app actions (create-chore, set-permission) — need robust function calling and structured output.

Security / compliance:
- Need SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration for encryption of persisted user prompts/PKV.
- Data residency: primary in NA but may require EU region for EU customers later.

Technical concerns & questions raised on call:
- "If we move to Dedicated, how much jitter reduction can we expect vs Hosted?" — SE to quantify with perf benchmarks for our access patterns.
- POC data handling: transient vs stored prompts — need guidance on retention controls and redaction.
- Streaming behavior: how to tune chunk sizes and first-byte latency for perceived snappiness.
